items.docs: The endpoint for the main search box in the UI

params.name: text
params.description: text to use for suggestions

params.name: size
params.description: Limit the size of the results

params.name: company_public_response
params.description: Filter the results to only return these types of public response by the company

params.name: company_received_max
params.description: Return results with date < company_received_max (i.e. 2017-03-04)

params.name: company_received_min
params.description: Return results with date >= company_received_min (i.e. 2017-03-04)

params.name: company_response
params.description: Filter the results to only return these types of response by the company

params.name: date_received_max
params.description: Return results with date < date_received_max (i.e. 2017-03-04)

params.name: date_received_min
params.description: Return results with date >= date_received_min (i.e. 2017-03-04)

params.name: has_narrative
params.description: Filter the results to only return the specified state of whether it has narrative in the complaint or not, i.e. yes, no

params.name: issue
params.description: Filter the results to only return these types of issue and subissue, i.e. product-only: Getting a Loan, subproduct needs to include product, separated by '•', Getting a Loan•Can't qualify for a loan

params.name: product
params.description: Filter the results to only return these types of product and subproduct, i.e. product-only: Mortgage, subproduct needs to include product, separated by '•', Mortgage•FHA mortgage

params.name: state
params.description: Filter the results to only return these states (use abbreviation, i.e. CA, VA)

params.name: submitted_via
params.description: Filter the results to only return these types of way consumers submitted their complaints

params.name: tags
params.description: Filter the results to only return these types of tag

params.name: timely
params.description: Filter the results to show whether a response was timely

params.name: zip_code
params.description: Filter the results to only return these zip codes
